versions.changelog:
Initial release: Enables true end-to-end autonomous agent integration and measurable evaluation.

- Integrates planner, execution, verification, reflection/replanning, memory, and evaluation engines into a real, measurable autonomous loop.
- Ensures all engines are hard dependencies and are explicitly imported and invoked in sequence—no silent failures or stub behavior.
- Provides comprehensive health scoring, including reliability, replan count, and pass rate, to determine if the agent loop is actually usable.
- Includes self-evolution features: usage and error patterns are automatically recorded and used to guide future improvements without manual maintenance.
- Offers CLI commands for one-click end-to-end self-test, custom task runs, and reporting/reflecting on skill usage and learning.
